decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix lies far from the firm's industrial waste-to-energy core and had only a minor web presence, so after several unobserved years a small venture-oriented firm will likely cut it and shift resources to its plant business.
The modular plant extensions complement the core waste-to-energy plants as a multi-model line and cost little to keep in the portfolio.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship with its own page in the firm's core direction, and rising energy prices in 2022 strengthen demand for decentralized energy.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is a strategic focus in a growing circular-economy and energy market, so the firm will keep developing it despite its modest web presence.
